run_self_chat: run a Parlai model self-chat for a given number of dialogue turns
run_self_chat_with_partner: run a self-chat between two different Parlai models using --partner-model-file
run_self_chat_seed_from_file: run a self-chat seeded with conversation starters from a newline-separated file
setup_args_self_chat: review the setup_args function to understand self-chat CLI argument configuration
save_self_chat_logs: run a self-chat and save conversation logs in JSONL or Parlai text format
